summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TRIRARA TUNGGAL PUTRA Hour Meter system with all new fields and features. Backend APIs fully functional with new Hour Meter fields (merek_type, pemilik_alat, nama_proyek, lokasi_proyek, pengawas_lapangan, downtime_jam, solar_liter, catatan_operator, kondisi_alat). Frontend successfully displays TRIRARA TUNGGAL PUTRA branding with logo, dark navy theme with yellow accents. All forms, dialogs, and export functionality working correctly.
